Tomas Brandt

Hiring Manager
GitLab

Dear Hiring Manager,

Rebuilding a forecast model around order backlog data lifted accuracy from 88% to 96% for a business unit I owned at Calder Industrial Components. That kind of work, turning messy operational data into reliable financial signals for decision-makers, is exactly what GitLab's FP&A team needs as it scales cloud and AI infrastructure spend.

Across five years of FP&A work in manufacturing and retail, I have owned full forecasting and variance analysis cycles, executed month-end close reporting, and built Power BI dashboards that translated SAP data into clear narratives for non-finance stakeholders. I also shortened close reporting from nine working days to six by automating journal checks in Excel VBA, which speaks directly to the operating efficiency GitLab values in its asynchronous environment. Cloud billing data is a new domain for me, but my experience interrogating detailed operational and transactional data with SQL, Power BI, and advanced Excel gives me a strong foundation to get productive quickly with provider billing exports and usage drivers.

I would welcome a conversation about how my forecasting and modeling background can support GitLab's engineering and finance leaders. I am available for an interview at your convenience.

Kind regards,
Tomas Brandt
